novelty_and_decision.if_complete_and_derivable: Retain one conditional complete C0 outside construction under frozen parent values, with new costs and global obligations. Decision changes from no asserted external resolved graph to an explicit graph that can be reviewed; no source/meaning winner, independent confirmation or translated anchor.
novelty_and_decision.if_roles_or_scope_conflict: Stop/reject that complete authored graph under frozen predicate/reference contract. Preserve raw counterexample and parent values; no repair. New graph inconsistency is not automatic English lexeme refutation.
novelty_and_decision.if_unknown_or_unbound: Stop as incomplete/missing binding; do not present17 coverage slots as full reading or repeat a capacity scan. No automatic decoder, reference-engine expansion or new glossary chain.
novelty_and_decision.if_only_fluent_source_fit: No scientific selection change. Semantic source fit and assigned counts alone cannot distinguish arbitrary competing atomic dictionaries.
novelty_and_decision.recommendation: Proceed only as one prospectively frozen bounded full17 authorship/review attempt after priors, preserving exact parent values/rules and transitive SHEDAR duties. It is legitimately different content work rather than another unchanged audit, but C0 completeness is the ceiling.
